title: poa nemoralis var. marginata
intro: Poa nemoralis var. marginata, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a perennial grass species found in various regions of the world, including Europe, Asia, and North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, as well as its therapeutic actions such as antiseptic and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Red Fescue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Poa nemoralis var. marginata on human health and its potential uses in traditional medicine.
